notes.methodology: Curated via web research (Wikipedia 118th/119th Congress articles + committee/member official pages, see sources) for: chamber leadership (Speaker, majority/minority leader, majority/minority whip) and chair + ranking member of Appropriations, Armed Services, Banking/Financial Services, Commerce (House: combined into Energy and Commerce), Energy (House: same Energy and Commerce committee; Senate: Energy and Natural Resources), Finance/Ways and Means, Foreign Affairs/Foreign Relations, HELP/Education and Workforce, Intelligence, Judiciary — both the 118th (2023-2024) and 119th (2025-2026) Congresses. Every slug below was then cross-checked against the REAL kadoa filer index (github.com/kadoa-org/congress-trading-monitor, public/data/filer directory listing, 437 entries fetched 2026-07-19) by grepping each member's surname. kadoa's filer index only contains members who have an actual STOCK Act periodic transaction report on file (i.e. who personally/spouse/dependent trade individual stock) -- members whose investments are entirely in mutual funds/index funds/blind trusts never file a PTR and so never appear, regardless of how senior their committee role is. That fully explains why prominent leaders like Schumer, McConnell (found, see below), Sanders, Grassley, etc. are a mixed bag below.
notes.verified_against_kadoa_index: Entries in this list marked verified were found EXACTLY in the live kadoa filer index (confirms both the person's presence and kadoa's slug format for them, which sometimes uses the member's full LEGAL name rather than their common name -- e.g. Ted Cruz -> senate_rafaele_cruz [Rafael E. Cruz], Bill Cassidy -> senate_william_cassidy, Jack Reed -> senate_johnf_reed [John F. Reed], Mitch McConnell -> senate_amitchell_mcconnelljr [A. Mitchell McConnell Jr.]). 31 unique people (of 60 unique people total) were verified this way.
notes.uncertain_slugs_caveat: These 29 people were NOT found in the live kadoa filer index under any name variant tried (common name, legal first name, middle initial) -- most plausibly because they simply have no PTR on file (index in mutual funds/blind trust), so this best-effort plain `{chamber}_{first}_{last}` slug is a guess that may not match kadoa's real filer_id if/when one of them does eventually file a stock trade. Harmless either way: power_only just won't match a wrong slug, it won't crash or misfire on someone else.
